fail_loud_inversion.command: occupy port 4000 with an HTTP 503 listener so the configured API process cannot start, then run the suite
fail_loud_inversion.observed: Playwright exited 1 with `Error: Process from config.webServer was not able to start. Exit code: 1`.
fail_loud_inversion.honest_reading: This is the control that matters for this lane. The specs assert against a real API rather than a route mock, so the failure mode to exclude is the suite going green because the API never came up. It does not.

connected_not_mocked.detail: phase-one.spec.ts asserts /api/health/runtime reports persistenceMode=in_memory and runtimeMode=fail_open before submitting, then reads the submitted pick back out of the API's own repository. Reference-data responses remain fixture-backed route mocks; the submission path is not mocked.
connected_not_mocked.significance: Before this lane the submission cases fulfilled POST /api/submissions from a page.route handler and inspected the captured payload, so nothing downstream of the browser was exercised.

track_only_non_delivery.detail: Both connected submissions are asserted to remain status=validated with outboxId=null and outboxStatus=null through GET /api/qa/pick-status/:id.
track_only_non_delivery.scope_honesty: This is asserted against the local isolated in-memory API, not against staging or production. It demonstrates the browser-to-API contract; it is not the Milestone 1 non-delivery observation, which must be made against the deployed system.

stale_offer_boundary.detail: The past-start NCAAF event's browse route asserts a non-empty recentSince search parameter, so a scheduled event whose start has passed cannot silently consume stale offer prices.

signed_values_round_trip.detail: A browser-entered spread of -3.5 and American odds of +105 reach the real API and are read back from its repository as numbers, preserving sign.

honest_missing_coverage.detail: The manual-override case persists null canonical IDs together with explicit canonical-coverage-gap manual provenance, rather than fabricating a canonical resolution it did not have.

no_production_credentials.observed: The API webServer env blanks SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, sets UNIT_TALK_API_RATE_LIMIT_STORE=memory and UNIT_TALK_APP_ENV=local, and both servers bind 127.0.0.1.
no_production_credentials.significance: No live delivery target and no production credential is reachable from this suite.

reserved_surface_untouched.significance: No workflow, no migration, and no package source changed. The diff is four Smart Form e2e/test-config files plus this lane's own metadata and proof.

runtime_proof.detail: Static-proof delivery-ui lane. The runtime it exercises is deliberately local and contained — Chromium to a Next dev server to an API HTTP route to an isolated in-memory repository and back. It contacts no production system and claims no writable staging or database evidence.

known_gaps: CI invocation is deliberately not part of this slice. The suite added here is not yet run by any workflow: .github/workflows/qa-fast.yml and the root package.json wiring are assigned to a separate singleton-approved hygiene lane, because qa-fast.yml currently converts a SKIP into a green check (exit code 1 is swallowed; only exit 2 propagates) and that defect must be repaired in the same change that starts depending on it, not inherited.

The Track Only non-delivery and persisted-pick assertions here run against a local in-memory API. They demonstrate the browser-to-API contract. They are not, and must not be read as, the Milestone 1 step-6 and step-7 observations, which require the deployed system.

real-reference.spec.ts still skips when connected canonical reference data is absent. It skips loudly with a named reason rather than passing, but a skip is not evidence, and this lane does not populate reference data.
